mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has risen from -28.0 to -20.4 over four weeks, indicating a steady return of commuting activity. Continued recovery of workplace attendance generates incidental retail footfall near office corridors, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the subsequent two weeks even though TRANSIT holds above -15 for two consecutive weeks.
